title: Collagen rigidity audit: 324 cases, independent load paths and a singular buckling branch
evidence: Saved synthetic dimensionless mechanical study; no molecular or tissue calibration
units: Dimensionless model units unless a column explicitly names units
limitations: 324 finite-network commissioning cases;310passed and14rejected states, not empirical collagen validation.
Free-network zero modes, boundary-clamped stiffness and singular buckling branch must remain distinct.
Continuum export arbitrary stress units; no cohesive, fatigue or relaxation law.

Spectra retain signed eigenvalues and each saved tolerance. Near-zero free-network modes include rigid-body/component motions; do not interpret every zero as a nontrivial mechanism or tiny negative roundoff as buckling.
